links.outcome: Readability grade level of ChatGPT responses versus physician responses to patient questions
links.effect: Physician responses had significantly higher ease of readability and lower grade-level readability than ChatGPT (p < 0.001); ChatGPT responses exceeded average American literacy.
links.quote: However, these responses are at readability levels higher than the literacy of the average American population.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of chatbot answers to patient questions, measured with six readability indexes
links.effect: Physician responses had significantly higher ease of readability and lower grade-level readability compared to ChatGPT (p < 0.001).
links.quote: Physician responses had significantly higher ease of readability and lower grade-level readability compared to ChatGPT (p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Using chatbot responses to assist physicians in drafting replies to patient questions on social media

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's capability (accuracy, completeness, empathy, and readability) to answer neurosurgical patient questions compared to physician responses from Reddit, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
